about: A fast feathered hunting dinosaur the size of a person; it chirps and screeches to its pack.
notes: v1 brief for the torch backend (MOSS-SoundEffect v2.0 on CUDA). Each prompt asks for several events with pauses in one 8 s file, and the picker cuts the best of them. Slots with loop: true are beds: the picker cuts a seamless stretch.

prompts.text: A feathered hunting dinosaur gives sharp chirping barks and clicking trills, three separate calls with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A feathered predator dinosaur shrieks a sharp piercing screech, three separate screeches with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A feathered predator dinosaur yelps and squeals in pain, four separate cries with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A feathered predator dinosaur gives a weak gurgling dying screech that fades, two separate times with long pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A predator dinosaur snarls and snaps its jaws shut in a fast bite, five separate bites with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
Quick light footsteps of a running clawed animal on earth: fast scratchy taps, separate bursts. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
